candidates.description: This vector represents traditional Germanic and European male given names.
This feature vector represents the root concept of science, knowledge, and consciousness across various morphological forms and languages.
This feature activates for terms, roots, and prefixes related to psychology, psychiatry, and neurology.
This feature vector represents common German grammatical articles, pronouns, and prepositions frequently used at the beginning or within clauses.
This vector represents Greek and Latin roots, suffixes, and combining forms used in academic, scientific, and philosophical terminology.
This vector represents French demonstrative determiners and related proximal or definite modifiers.
This feature vector activates strongly on the German suffix "-ich" and words containing it.
These tokens represent French personal and emphatic pronouns across various cases and genders.
This vector represents common French and German prepositions and prepositional contractions.
This vector activates on words, name roots, and morphological fragments starting with the letters "an".
